title: Felix and the Hollow
author: Cyrus Lockridge
blurb: Silas Pemberton, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
